# Repository description and topics

Prepared locally for the repository's **About** section. Apply these values on
GitHub only after the maintainer authorizes the update.

## Description

Game streaming from Sunshine or NVIDIA GameStream to Samsung Smart TVs (Tizen), with a controller-first library and Wake-on-LAN.

## Topics

```text
moonlight
moonlight-tizen
tizen
samsung-smart-tv
sunshine
gamestream
game-streaming
wake-on-lan
gamepad
webassembly
```

The description and topics identify the platform, host software and main
features. They make no compatibility or performance claim beyond the README.
